data.title: ALS Says Director Siddhartha Kadia Submitted Resignation

data.title: DGR Global Updates Armour Energy Administration and Receivership Case
data.description:
DGR Global Limited ( (AU:DGR) ) has issued an announcement.

DGR Global creates resource exploration, development and mining companies, using a core team of geoscientists to identify resource projects and attractive commodities. Its stated selection criteria include favourable 20-year price outlooks, endowed but under-explored geological areas, recently developed exploration techniques, improving jurisdictions and available tenures.

DGR said it filed an appeal on 30 October 2026 challenging refusal of some pleading amendments in its Armour Energy administration and receivership case; its current claim is AU$28,594,971, while a proposed alternative claim was up to AU$73,442,066. DGR has filed amended pleadings to the extent leave was granted. Three costs processes remain underway, including claims by DGR for AU$539,859.21 and AU$1,440,876.96, and a AU$466,924.85 claim served against DGR; the release cautions amounts may differ from final payments.

data.title: Mirae Asset Details KRW 19.8 Billion Very-High-Risk Equity-Linked Securities
data.description:
MIRAE ASSET SECURITIES CO., LTD. ( (KR:006800) ) just unveiled an update.

The release details Mirae Asset Securities No. 36749, an unlisted equity-linked security with a total offering amount of KRW 19.8 billion, 2 million securities and a KRW 10,000 face value per security. The product is linked to the EUROSTOXX50, S&P500 and KOSPI200 indexes and is offered at KRW 9,900 per security, with a minimum subscription of KRW 990,000.

Principal is not guaranteed, and the product is not covered by the Depositor Protection Act. The release warns that the securities are complex, may be difficult to exit before maturity, and could incur losses exceeding 20% of principal at maturity or automatic early redemption, while issuer credit risk also applies.

data.title: Aspial Invites Exchange of 2027 Notes for 2030 Notes
data.description:
Aspial Corporation Limited ( (SG:A30) ) just unveiled an update.

Aspial Corporation Limited, incorporated in Singapore, is the issuer of notes under a S$700 million multicurrency debt issuance programme. It invited holders of its outstanding 6.50% notes due 2 July 2027 to exchange any or all holdings for an equal principal amount of 5.60% notes due 2030.

The exchange consideration comprises equivalent principal in new notes, cash equal to 0.60% of exchanged principal and accrued interest. The notice covers S$43.5 million outstanding, while Aspial and its subsidiaries hold S$1.25 million; notes not exchanged remain outstanding under unchanged terms.

data.title: ConnectM Technology Solutions Extends Yorkville Note Maturity Under Agreement
data.description:
ConnectM Technology Solutions ( (CNTM) ) has shared an update.

ConnectM Technology Solutions entered a Settlement and Termination Agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. on December 29, 2025, concerning its Standby Equity Purchase Agreement and related promissory note. The agreement provided for $250,000 cash payments on alternate Mondays toward the Pre-Paid Advance Obligation, while timely payments restricted Yorkville from delivering Investor Notices or deemed Advance Notices for 14 days.

On November 11, 2026, the company and Yorkville entered a letter agreement that acknowledged $600,000 of principal and $56,219 of accrued interest, with interest accruing at $296 per day thereafter, and extended the Note’s maturity to January 15, 2027. If an IPO closes, the agreement provides for payment of the payoff amount within three business days and allows up to $250,000 of securities to be allocated to Yorkville through a reduction of the obligation; other settlement terms remained in effect.

data.title: MacKenzie Realty Capital Holds Annual Meeting and Elects Directors
data.description:
MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc. ( (MKZR) ) has provided an update.

MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc., a Maryland corporation, held its annual meeting on November 16, 2026, with proposals to elect four directors and ratify Baker Tilly, LLP as independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2027. A quorum was reached with 1,508,476 shares, or 54.37% of shares outstanding and eligible to vote, present.

All four director nominees were elected to serve until the 2027 annual meeting and successor qualification, with more than 75% of shares present voting for each. Stockholders ratified Baker Tilly, LLP, with 1,350,510 votes for, 122,666 against and 35,300 abstentions; 89.53% of shares present voted for ratification, and no broker non-votes were cast.
